correctness.rationale: For every n>=4, a strong induced four-tournament is equivalent to a directed Hamiltonian 4-cycle, one per 4-set. Conditional on a shared cyclic triple, strong-extension probability is 3/4; on a transitive triple it is 1/4. Counting 3-in-4 nested overlaps gives Cov(X,Y)=3/8*binom(n,4); two 4-sets sharing a triple have covariance 3/64, giving Var(Y)=3(n-3)(4n-11)/256*binom(n,3). Distinct triangle indicators are pairwise uncorrelated, giving Var(X)=3/16*binom(n,3). Regression slope (n-3)/2, correlation squared 4(n-3)/(4n-11), residual fraction 1/(4n-11) then follow algebraically. Independently enumerated all 64 n=4 and 1024 n=5 fair tournaments by direct reachability and exact fractions; moments agree. The unrestricted statements follow from overlap counting.
